6788.title: OpenCode workspace command roots missing before a session
6788.rootCauseOneLine: The built-in OpenCode declaration and native-root resolver supply skill roots but no project command roots, so the pre-session catalog never scans command files.
6788.proposedFix: Return the existing project command directory from the OpenCode native-root resolver, with ancestor traversal and no-workspace handling.
6788.caveats: Direct catalog reproduction in two clean Linux checkouts; macOS desktop UI and real OpenCode sessions were not driven. Global/custom-config command discovery is outside the narrow candidate fix.
